description: This file defines a Java class SelfAccountTransferData used to hold transfer data options for self account transfers within the Fineract system. It contains collections of account options for 'from' and 'to' accounts.

classes.name: SelfAccountTransferData
classes.description: A data container class providing options for from and to accounts in a self-account transfer context.

methods.name: SelfAccountTransferData
methods.description: Constructor initializing the account options for from and to accounts in a self-account transfer.
